Method of Attack: Malware distribution via phishing emails using malicious Microsoft Office document attachments with VBA and XL4 macros
Switch to container files such as ISO, RAR, ZIP archives
Use of Windows Shortcut (LNK) files to execute commands including PowerShell scripts to download and execute malware
Use of HTML attachments employing HTML smuggling technique to drop malicious files
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious attachments (docx, xls, ISO, RAR, ZIP, LNK, HTML)
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious LNK files masquerading as Word documents
PowerShell commands executed via LNK files
HTML smuggling technique in HTML attachments
